name: f_md5_uuid_vs_oracle_rating_result_inputs
source_sql: SELECT period_id AS "input", SUBSTR(LOWER(RAWTOHEX(STANDARD_HASH(UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_RAW(period_id), 'MD5'))),1,8)||'-'||SUBSTR(LOWER(RAWTOHEX(STANDARD_HASH(UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_RAW(period_id), 'MD5'))),9,4)||'-'||SUBSTR(LOWER(RAWTOHEX(STANDARD_HASH(UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_RAW(period_id), 'MD5'))),13,4)||'-'||SUBSTR(LOWER(RAWTOHEX(STANDARD_HASH(UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_RAW(period_id), 'MD5'))),17,4)||'-'||SUBSTR(LOWER(RAWTOHEX(STANDARD_HASH(UTL_RAW.CAST_TO_RAW(period_id), 'MD5'))),21,12) AS "hashed" FROM ow_billing.rating_results ORDER BY period_id
target_sql: SELECT input AS input, billing.f_md5_uuid(input) AS hashed FROM billing.md5_parity_input WHERE vector = 'rating_result' ORDER BY input
